text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"Clear thesis in the opening: \"I do not support the development of them\"","quality":"explicit stance","description":"The essay states its position directly and leaves no doubt about what it is arguing for."},{"evidence":"Paragraphs on roadwork, driver attention, and laws","quality":"organization","description":"The argument is laid out in separate points that each address a different concern, making the essay easier to follow."},{"evidence":"Uses article ideas about roadwork, driver alerts, and new laws","quality":"source use","description":"The essay repeatedly ties its claims back to the reading rather than relying mainly on unsupported opinion."},{"evidence":"\"Which brings me to my next point\" and repeated transitions like \"In conclusion\"","quality":"transitions","description":"The writing uses signposting to move the reader through the argument and connect ideas smoothly."},{"evidence":"Final paragraph returns to confusion over laws and fault","quality":"conclusion","description":"The ending restates the main reasons and brings the argument to a clear closing point."}]}
